Poster: 'irrigation', with image of a man using bricks to channel water. Purple background, white text. Part of series detailing problems and solutions.

Poster: ‘“So distribution should undo excess, and each man have enough.” Shakespeare. (King Lear)’, with sepia photograph of a child in rags. Brown background, brown text. Part of the Bother Poster series.
